dedupe_keys.name: equipements publics avec acces wifi public

description: Equipements publics avec acces wifi public is a dataset listed in Cachan open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Cachan. Cachan propose un accès wifi gratuit dans plusieurs bâtiments municipaux. Dans chaque quartier de la ville, des outils informatiques et des aides à l’utilisation de ces outils sont à disposition du public. Le CCAS met à disposition du public, pour effectuer ses démarches administratives, un ordinateur et une imprimante multifonction en libre accès. Coverage: Cachan. The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are numerique, wifi, free wifi, equipements, Au quotidien. The portal shows 6 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-08-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cachan-portal.
